reclamaciones.corpus: 200 samples across two comparative datasets (100 EN · 100 multilingual), split 50-20-15-15
reclamaciones.falla: BOTH fail as a product and prove it works as a pipeline. The English one PICKED a deadline, which is exactly what is forbidden. The multilingual one refused correctly but invented a reference number by mixing the figures in the question with the corpus pattern. Neither routes to an official channel nor offers escalation. With 100 samples and loss 0.62 and 0.33, this is memorisation, not learning

supervision-humana.util: Being able to show that a person looked at an answer before it went out, and that what they looked at is exactly what went out.
supervision-humana.hoy: Nothing drawn yet. What does exist is the chained log a record has to point at.
supervision-humana.falta: The split screen: the raw proposal on one side, the human edit on the other, and a button that seals. And today it seals with a hash, not a signature: a hash shows the text did not change, not who approved it. Said before building it, because that is the difference between evidence and decoration.
supervision-humana.aportas: Tell me what you have to prove in your work, and to whom.

barra-corte.falta: Drawing it. Four zooms --day, week, month, year-- and the whole background, on all three surfaces. If the span cannot be drawn, the line was not linear yet.
barra-corte.aportas: Tell me what period you look at when you review something.
